name: Three Typical Candles
summary: This EA identifies a specific three-candle pattern formation to generate trading signals. It enters positions when three consecutive typical candles meet predefined criteria, suggesting a potential reversal or continuation move. The system applies fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels to manage trades automatically.
summary_zh: 该EA通过识别特定的三根K线形态组合来产生交易信号。当连续三根典型K线满足预定义条件时，系统认为可能出现反转或延续走势，从而进场交易。系统采用固定的止盈止损水平来自动管理持仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于三根K线形态的识别来判断市场方向。入场条件为连续三根K线形成特定形态组合（如三白兵、三黑鸦或其变体），满足条件后开仓做多或做空。出场条件依赖预设的固定止盈和止损值，部分版本可能包含追踪止损功能。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理方面较为基础，通常使用固定风险比例或固定手数，缺乏动态调整机制。整体策略逻辑简单直观，但对市场环境的适应性有限，在震荡市中可能产生较多虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on identifying a three-candle pattern formation to determine market direction. Entry conditions require three consecutive candles forming a specific pattern combination (such as three white soldiers, three black crows, or their variants), after which a long or short position is opened. Exit conditions rely on preset fixed take-profit and stop-loss values, with some versions possibly including a trailing stop feature. Position sizing employs fixed lot sizes or lot calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management is relatively basic, typically using a fixed risk ratio or fixed lots without dynamic adjustment mechanisms. The overall strategy logic is simple and intuitive but has limited adaptability to different market conditions, potentially generating numerous false signals in ranging markets.

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证
基于K线形态的交易方法具有直观的市场含义
固定止盈止损提供了明确的风险控制边界
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and verify
Candlestick pattern-based trading has intuitive market significance
Fixed take-profit and stop-loss provide defined risk control boundaries
cons: K线形态识别在震荡市中容易产生虚假信号
缺乏市场环境过滤机制，无法区分趋势和盘整
资金管理较为基础，未考虑波动率动态调整仓位
cons_en: Candlestick pattern recognition easily generates false signals in ranging markets
Lacks market environment filtering mechanism, cannot distinguish trending from consolidating markets
Money management is basic, does not consider volatility for dynamic position sizing
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线或ATR）以避免在震荡市中交易
引入基于ATR的动态止盈止损，适应不同波动率环境
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as moving average or ATR) to avoid trading in ranging markets
Introduce ATR-based dynamic take-profit and stop-loss to adapt to different volatility environments

risk_points: 缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线内重复开仓
固定止损未考虑市场波动率，在低波动时可能过宽在高波动时可能过窄
risk_points_en: Lacks new bar check mechanism, may repeatedly open positions within the same bar
Fixed stop-loss does not consider market volatility, may be too wide in low volatility and too narrow in high volatility
